test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
When the following figure is folded to form a cube, which letter-number will be on the face opposite to the face showing the letter-number 'A1'?

(The elements are shown to indicate the sides only.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54f3c2b87582851fb606c84fd2fa6a4c0ce6865be0591517155dbbbd226d0891.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

from the given open dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0eb2843cbd5c9b690a6eeb2b6386e34373e7effa001fe0ac56658730ec42c5.png] 

as you can see in the above figure.

**U5 is opposite to A1**

**O4 is opposite to E2**

**I3 is opposite to Z6**

Therefore like this opposite of **"A1" will be "U5"**

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 1**
